source.title: Junior School Curriculum Design - Agriculture - Grade 8
source.notes: KICD's own Google Drive index (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1MzOFhLc8kbRwvjg03q7oeDrbbvux75Wy/preview, confirmed via WebFetch) shows the official filename as 'Agriculture Grade8 1.8.2024 - Proofread.pdf', but that Drive file is download-blocked so its text could not be read directly. Direct kicd.ac.ke hosting attempts (e.g. wp-content/uploads/2024/01/GRADE-8-AGRICULTURE-NUTRITION.pdf, found via web search) returned 404 -- likely reorganised/removed since the 2024 revision. The document actually read here (via WebFetch's saved-local-copy + Read, full text read verbatim, NOT summarized) is doyenpublishers.com's mirror. Its title page reads 'KENYA INSTITUTE OF CURRICULUM DEVELOPMENT / JUNIOR SCHOOL CURRICULUM DESIGN / AGRICULTURE / GRADE 8', 'First published 2023 / Revised 2024', ISBN 978-9914-43-980-9, confirming it is authentically a KICD-produced document in the correct revision lineage (matches app's subject name closely enough -- note the official title is simply 'Agriculture', not 'Agriculture and Nutrition', though the design covers both agriculture and home-science/nutrition topics as an integrated learning area per its own essence statement). Strand/sub-strand structure, specific learning outcomes and key inquiry questions below were transcribed verbatim from this PDF's text (read directly via the Read tool, not AI-summarized), cross-checked against the 'SUMMARY OF STRANDS AND SUB STRANDS' table (p.x) which matched the full per-strand breakdown (p.1-21) exactly. Marked high confidence because the full text was read verbatim and the strand/sub-strand list is short and unambiguous (12 sub-strands total, matching the summary table count exactly).

subStrands.name: Soil Conservation Measures
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe methods of soil conservation in agricultural environment
Carry out soil conservation activities in the environment
Demonstrate caring attitude towards soil in the environment
keyInquiryQuestions: How can we conserve soil in the environment?

subStrands.name: Water Harvesting and Storage
specificLearningOutcomes: Discuss ways of storing harvested water for domestic use
Take part in harvesting and storing water in the school for domestic use
Show responsibility in harvesting and storing water for domestic use
keyInquiryQuestions: How can we harvest and store water for domestic purposes?

subStrands.name: Kitchen and Backyard Gardening
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain the role of kitchen and backyard garden in food production
Establish a kitchen and backyard garden for food production
Adopt the use of kitchen and backyard garden for food production
keyInquiryQuestions: How does kitchen garden contribute to food production?

subStrands.name: Poultry Rearing in a Fold
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe a fold in poultry rearing
Construct a fold for rearing poultry
Rear poultry in a fold
Show responsibility in rearing of poultry
keyInquiryQuestions: How can we rear poultry in a fold for food production?

subStrands.name: Crop Pest and Disease Control
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases
Control pests and diseases on vegetable crops
Acknowledge importance of controlling pests and diseases in vegetable production
keyInquiryQuestions: How can we identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases?
How can we control pests and diseases affecting crops?

subStrands.name: Preparation of Animal Products
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain the importance of processing fish and dressing poultry carcass
Process fresh fish for various purposes
Dress poultry carcass for various purposes
Uphold ethical and safety practices in preparation of animal products
keyInquiryQuestions: How can we process fresh fish?
How can we dress poultry carcass?

subStrands.name: Preserving Animal Products
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain the importance of preserving milk and meat at household level
Preserve meat to prolong shelf life at household level
Preserve milk to prolong shelf life at household level
Embrace the use of various methods to preserve animal products at household level
keyInquiryQuestions: How can we preserve milk and meat at household level?

subStrands.name: Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain factors to consider in preparing a balanced meal
Prepare a balanced meal for healthy living
Use various styles to present the meal
Adopt the use of a balanced meal in day to day life
keyInquiryQuestions: How can we prepare a balanced meal for healthy living?

subStrands.name: Cleaning the Kitchen
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain the routine cleaning practices of a kitchen
Carry out cleaning of a kitchen to maintain hygiene
Appreciate the importance of a clean kitchen for healthy living
keyInquiryQuestions: How can daily, weekly and special cleaning enhance hygiene in the kitchen?

subStrands.name: Sewing Skills: Constructing Household Items
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify types of seams used in making household items
Make samples of seams on a piece of cloth
Construct a household item using seams
Appreciate the use of seam in making household items
keyInquiryQuestions: How can a household item be made using seams?

subStrands.name: Constructing Innovative Animal Waterer
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain challenges with animal waterers used in the community
Design and construct an innovative waterer for water conservation
Appreciate use of innovative waterers in animal rearing
keyInquiryQuestions: How can we make an innovative waterer for small domestic animals?

subStrands.name: ICT Support Services
specificLearningOutcomes: Describe support services that can be accessed through use of ICT
Access support services using ICT
Show responsibility in use of ICT in accessing support services
keyInquiryQuestions: How can we access support services using ICT?
